Lanchana K Senior Network Engineer (System Administration) Bangalore, Karnataka - INDIA Email Id: lanchanak8@gmail.com Mob: 6362250872

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY As a Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) with 8 years of experience, I bring expertise in Routing and Switching, Nexus Switching, Cisco ACI-DCI, VMWare NSX-T, and change implementation. I have hands-on experience implementing Cisco Application Centric Datacenter Infrastructure and Nexus Dashboard, NDFC, NDO and My skills extend to team management, ensuring successful project execution and delivery. To enhance my knowledge in networking with highly efficient workgroup by utilizing my talent & skills and aspire to crave my career as in the field of Network Operation, Management & Administration.

SKILLS

➢ CCNA Routing & Switching, Cisco ACI-DCI, NDFC-Nexus, Nexus

Dashboard Orchestrator (NDO), VMware NSX-T.

➢ Network Protocols: RIP, EIGRP, OSPF BGP, TACACS, STP, FTP, VPC, VSS, TCP/IP, DHCP, LAN, WAN, VLAN, VTP, HSRP, Port Security, Ethernet, SNMP, Telnet, SSH.

➢ Logical Constructs - Tenants, Bridge Domain, Application Profile,

Interface profile, Interface selectors, EPGs, L2 out, L3 out.

➢ Cisco routers, Catalyst switches, Nexus switches 9K, 7K and 5K, FEX

module, F5 Load balancer (Big-IP) and APIC controller.

➢ Always willing to innovate the new things which can improve the existing

technology.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Current Employer Role Description

Kyndryl (IBM-Kyndryl)

Senior Network Engineer (System Administration)

➢ Working as a part of Data center Network operations team which is responsible for configuring and maintaining network resources, ensuring Data Center Security and Monitoring with Cisco ACI technology.

➢ Kyndryl has 5 Datacenter across USA, each DC have the ACI fabric and the Layer 2

switches.

➢ Troubleshooting Issues like Link down, Reachability issue, Packet drops, Link flapping

and hardware related issues on Nexus 9K, 7K and 5K devices.

➢ Ensure technical and managerial escalation completed to defined time-scales and

ensure the issue to be resolved within the desired SLA timings.

➢ Arranging and coordinating with Field Engineer if remote resolution is not possible

(Device replacement).

➢ Working on Projects like VPC and LACP configuration across data centers. ➢ Experience in building logical Constructs like Bridge Domain, Application Profile,

EPGs, L2out, L3out and static binding etc. in Cisco ACI and NDO.

➢ Raising and performing the Normal change, Standard change and Emergency changes

whenever it is required as per the Network requirement.

➢ Prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Methods of Procedure (MOP)

for new configurations, troubleshooting, and upgrades.

➢ Monitor network performance and identify areas for improvement using SolarWinds

and Nexus Dashboard.

➢ Collaborate with the Cisco Technical Assistance Center (TAC) for software or

hardware-related issues and initiate Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) when it is necessary.

➢ Working on Replacement of new Nexus switch(9k,7k) when it is necessary. ➢ Worked on configuring the SNMP trap on the all the ACI switches to get the ticketing

for the Netcool.

➢ Working on the Integration of Netcool with Big panda for the Nexus, Out of Band

(OOB), and layer 2 devices.

➢ Troubleshooting the L3-out which is having the BGP and OSPF connectivity. ➢ Providing the On call support across all the DC. ➢ Upgrading the host and tenant and troubleshooting of F5 load balancer(Big- IP). ➢ Working on the capacity report for the weekly fashion for all the DC.

Previous Employer

Cerner Corporation India,

Role Description

Network Engineer II, May 2021 to May 2023

➢ Working on technologies like Cisco ACI and Fabric Path in datacenters. ➢ Troubleshooting for issues like link down, reachability issue, CRC errors, Link

flapping and hardware related issues.

➢ Working on Projects like VPC and LACP configuration across data centers and

SSD upgrade.

➢ Working on nexus switches 9K, 7K series. ➢ Support and maintain local area network, wide area network and wireless

network components.

➢ Provide 12/7 oncall support across Data Center. ➢ Responsible for Incident Management, Change management and Cisco TAC case

follow up.

Previous Employer

Vodafone Shared Services

Role Description

Network Consultant, December, 2017 to May 2021

➢ First line Troubleshooting of PE-CE routing issues, BGP, OSPF and MPLS ➢ Troubleshooting of customer networks to identify fault occurrences and carry out

1st line diagnostics & fix on multiple IP& Data technologies issues like Diagnostics of link down, flapping, BW issues, packet drops and latency issues.

➢ Providing Test Plans to isolate and rectify faults related to circuit degradation /

Packet drops and latency issues and shut-un shut the cisco switch port.

➢ Communicating in a timely fashion the status of major incidents and problems with the

customer and business stakeholders including executive management.

➢ Close coordination with Carriers across the world to isolate/rectify faults with

escalations also done in relevant times.

➢ Arranging and coordinating with Field Engineer if remote resolution is not possible

(device replacement).

TOOLS

 SNOW, Solar wind ,Remedy 9.1, Cramer , Cops, MORI, SMIT, Telnet Relay, Netcool, Bluecat, Secure CRT, Nethawk, Putty, JIRA, HPNA.

CERTIFICATION & TRAINING

 CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)

EDUCATIONAL DETAIL

 B.E in Electronics and Communication (2017) from SJCE, Mysore with CGPAof

8.28

EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES ANDACHIEVEMENTS

➢ Hosted multiple TV shows. ➢ Worked as host for Movie’s audio Launch. ➢ Multiple appreciations from College and Audients for being a wonderful host. ➢ Was appreciated with the award for highest number of Positive feedbacks from

customer.

PERSONAL DETAILS

➢ Date of Birth 12 September 1995 ➢ Gender

Female

➢ Language

English, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil.

Declaration:

I hereby declare that the above-mentioned details are true to the best of my

knowledge.Place: Bangalore

(Lanchana K)
